description: Defines the Netlink class, a wrapper for manipulating IP addresses and routing tables via netlink sockets in the quic namespace. It includes method declarations for getting link info, addresses, route info, and modifying routes and rules, as well as sending and receiving netlink messages.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: A class providing methods to manipulate IP addresses and routing tables using netlink sockets, not thread-safe but thread-compatible.

methods.name: Netlink
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Netlink object with a KernelInterface pointer.

methods.name: GetLinkInfo
methods.description: Retrieves link information for a specified network interface.

methods.name: GetAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves IP addresses associated with a network interface.

methods.name: ChangeLocalAddress
methods.description: Modifies local addresses on a network interface.

methods.name: GetRouteInfo
methods.description: Gets routing rules from the main routing table.

methods.name: ChangeRoute
methods.description: Adds, removes, or replaces routing rules.

methods.name: GetRuleInfo
methods.description: Retrieves all rules in the routing policy database.

methods.name: ChangeRule
methods.description: Adds, removes, or replaces routing rules.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a netlink message to the kernel.

methods.name: Recv
methods.description: Receives a netlink message from the kernel.
